title: Account Limits
subtitle: Review platform limits and grant focused exceptions without disabling protection for an entire account.
overrides_description: Overrides are applied only to the selected resource and quota.
empty_description: All accounts and groups currently use the platform defaults.

mode.observe_description: Limits are calculated and logged, but requests are not blocked. Set QUOTA_MODE=enforce after reviewing production usage.
mode.enforce_description: Requests that exceed an effective quota are blocked by the server.

delete_modal.title: Remove quota override?
delete_modal.description: {subject} will immediately return to the platform default.
delete_modal.warning: New actions may be blocked if current usage is already above the default limit.
